root_cause: The existing source radar exclusively queried consumer personal-life complaints. The materializer marked office problems and business bridge forbidden, while the orchestrator explicitly requested daily-life Instagram captions without office problems or business moral. Frozen consumer-signal winners therefore could not express the stored PH-P SME problem or a concrete portal action.
prevention: Filter fresh source evidence to verified entrepreneur problem taxonomy PH-Pnnn and map the source signal to exactly one supported problem ID.
Do not replace or mutate an existing Instagram daily winner; future daily winner remains source-backed and immutable.
Make the content-orchestrator produce a complete Dutch caption from that same winner and its canonical PH-P scene, consequence, portal capability, next action and measurement point.
Pass the structured problem to the original media router and pre-publish reviewer; continue the exact final Mira identity, frame, dedupe and provider readback guards.
Keep channel-separated content and make no fake customer facts, measured ROI or claimed public post without provider evidence.
